meta_description: Green Leaf Electrical Services in Newcastle. Domestic and commercial electrical work, fault-finding, and rewires. NICEIC certified. Call 07512 547319 for a free quote.
hero_subhead: Blown fuses, flickering lights, or a complete rewire needed? Green Leaf diagnoses and fixes electrical faults fast—no unnecessary delays.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full house rewires, we handle domestic and commercial electrical work with speed and precision.

services.title: Emergency Fault Diagnosis
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped electrics, or dead sockets? We diagnose the problem and fix it the same day. No guesswork, no hidden charges.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Old wiring putting you at risk? We upgrade your entire electrical system to modern safety standards, often completing homes in 3–5 days.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Replace outdated fuse boxes with modern RCD-protected consumer units. Safer, more reliable, and needed before selling or remortgaging most homes.

services.title: Landlord Safety Certificates
services.desc: Satisfy your legal duty. We test all properties and issue an EICR certificate valid for five years—required by law for all rental homes.

services.title: New Socket & Lighting Installation
services.desc: Adding new circuits for a kitchen refit, conservatory, or office? We run the cables and test everything to Building Regulations.

services.title: Commercial Electrical Work
services.desc: Small shops to larger commercial premises. We install, test, and maintain business electrical systems and keep you compliant with regulations.

about_pullquote: We show up when we say we will, charge what we quote, and never rush the job.
about_para_1: Green Leaf Electrical Services was founded in Newcastle 18 years ago by Mike Green, a qualified electrician tired of seeing customers overcharged and left waiting. We started with one van and a simple promise: honest work at fair prices. Today, we've completed over 2,400 jobs across Newcastle and the North East, and we still answer our own phones. NICEIC registration and up-to-date Part P certification mean your work is guaranteed and insurable.
about_para_2: Homeowners and landlords trust us because we diagnose problems thoroughly, explain what's needed in plain English, and stick to our quotes. Whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned rewire, we treat every customer's home with the same care we'd give our own. Repeat bookings and personal referrals make up most of our work—the best compliment we can get.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Came out on a Sunday when our lights went out in half the house. Diagnosed a faulty RCD unit in under an hour and had us back to normal by lunchtime. Honest bloke, fair price, and didn't try to sell us stuff we didn't need. Will definitely call again.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: We're landlords renting out a flat in Gateshead. Mike sorted our EICR certificate without fuss and even found a couple of minor issues we didn't know about. Very professional and explained everything clearly. Highly recommended for anyone needing a safety certificate.
reviews.author: Priya K.

reviews.text: Full rewire on our 1960s terrace—we were worried it'd take forever and cause chaos. They finished in 4 days, minimal disruption, and the whole house is now safe. Best money we've spent on the house. Wouldn't use anyone else.
reviews.author: Karen M.
